source: WOOD Magazine, Make and Mount Super-Simple Drawers, Size the drawer to fit the hole
conversion: 1 in = 25.4 mm; full-extension slides require 1/2 in per side, so a 20 in opening yields a 19 in box width.
tolerance: 0.01 mm for the published box-width value after unit conversion.
scope: Validates only drawer-box width for the source's full-extension, side-mount slide clearance. Height, depth, false-front size, and bottom/center slide clearances are excluded.
